page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 2 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth scale to average levels, as shown by stress-ng multi-core and uncached large-block read/write tests. The instance exhibits weaker performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and multi-threaded decompression, indicating a tradeoff when handling highly concurrent or memory-bound workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC architecture provides high single-threaded compute density without the overhead of bundled storage or GPU resources. This makes the instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints or local disk storage, such as single-threaded processing, text processing, and lightweight web serving.
